findings.summary: A workspace write can land outside the reviewed workspace.
findings.failureScenario: Open workspace B, then submit a write queued from workspace A; the file lands in B.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the owning runtime before the write.
findings.outcomeNote: Writes now resolve the runtime first.

findings.summary: The bundle step emits a deprecation warning for the banner plugin.
findings.shortSummary: The bundle step emits a deprecation warning for the banner…
findings.failureScenario: npm run bundle prints the plugin deprecation on every build, masking new warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Pin the plugin option the warning names.

findings.summary: Pagination test fails on the PR build.
findings.shortSummary: Pagination test fails on the PR build.
findings.failureScenario: vitest reports the pagination spec red on the PR side; the same command is red on the merge base too.
findings.outcomeNote: Red on the merge base as well; not caused by this change.
